title: Aurora Hare Temple
description: A surreal portrait of a woman with large pink rabbit ears and flowing pink hair adorned with glowing green energy patterns. She wears a heart-shaped necklace and is set against a cosmic temple dome filled with an audience, floating castles, and vibrant aurora borealis over mountains.
prompt: A surreal digital painting of a beautiful woman with large glowing pink rabbit ears and long flowing pink hair that swirls with green energy patterns. She has striking yellow-green eyes and wears a necklace of glowing hearts. In the background is a massive cosmic temple dome filled with an audience, floating fantasy castles, and a vibrant green and purple aurora borealis over dark mountains. Psychedelic fantasy style with intricate details.
